title: Dry-run preview in RunNowModal
description:
Wire the dry-run simulation endpoint into the RunNowModal. When the operator checks "Preview safety decisions," the modal calls the dry-run endpoint and shows per-step results before the actual run starts.

**File:** `dashboard/src/components/workflows/RunNowModal.tsx` (modify)

**Behavior:**
1. Enable the dry-run checkbox (currently disabled placeholder)
2. When checked + "Preview" button clicked: call `POST /api/v1/workflows/:id/dry-run` with the form input
3. Show results inline below the form:
   - List of steps with safety decision badges: ✅ Allow, ❌ Deny, 👤 Require Approval, ⏳ Throttle, ➖ N/A
   - For denied steps: show reason in red
   - For approval steps: show reason in yellow with "This step will pause for approval" note
4. "Start Run" button still available after preview — operator can proceed knowing what will happen
5. If any step is denied: show a warning banner "1 step will be denied by policy — the run will fail at that step"

**Hook:** Create `useDryRun(workflowId)` mutation hook in `useWorkflows.ts`.
definitionOfDone: Per-step safety decisions displayed with badges
Operator can still proceed after preview

implementationPlan.note: Added DryRunStepResult, DryRunResult, DryRunInput interfaces and useDryRun() mutation hook. POSTs to /workflows/:id/dry-run with input and environment.
